Playbook.name: NETSCOUT AED — Volumetric DDoS Surge Against a Bank Internet Service - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: NETSCOUT AED reported a surge of volumetric-flood events (SYN/ICMP/rate-based/malformed) against a protected bank service (threshold now 10/protection-group/hour). Triage: an active DDoS attack on an internet-facing banking service, or a benign traffic spike/misconfiguration?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: A volumetric DDoS can take internet banking offline - an availability and reputational impact.

Assets.AssetType: Bank internet-facing services behind NETSCOUT AED (DDoS protection)

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: NETSCOUT Arbor Edge Defense CEF (verified live). Fields: source.ip, source.geo, source.as.organization.name, destination.ip, cef.extensions.deviceCustomString2 (protection group / bank service), cef.device.event_class_id (attack type), cef.extensions.deviceCustomString6 (threat category), cef.severity.

Signal.Name: Volumetric DDoS Surge Against a Bank Int
Signal.Details: flood events against a protection group.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the flood surge is an active DDoS on a bank service and its scale/source.

Step.name: Flood events, types and scale for the protection group
Step.Purpose: The event types, count and whether AED is blocking show the attack's nature and whether mitigation is holding.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE observer.vendor == "NETSCOUT" AND cef.extensions.deviceCustomString2 == "$protgroup" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), attack_types = VALUES(cef.device.event_class_id), sources = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.ip), src_countries = VALUES(source.geo.country_name) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Many flood events (SYN/ICMP flood, rate-based blocking) from many sources = a real volumetric DDoS. AED blocking them = mitigation active. A single source or a small spike may be a scanner or a traffic anomaly.

Step.name: Top attacking sources
Step.Purpose: The source distribution (many IPs/countries vs one) distinguishes a distributed attack from a single noisy source.
Step.Query: FROM logs-cef.log-* | WHERE observer.vendor == "NETSCOUT" AND cef.extensions.deviceCustomString2 == "$protgroup" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), countries = VALUES(source.geo.country_name), asns = VALUES(source.as.organization.name) BY source.ip | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15
Step.AnalystNotes: Many distinct sources across countries = distributed (real DDoS). Concentrated from one ASN may be a single attacker or a misrouted flow.

Node.Condition: Distributed flood events from many sources against a bank internet service.
Node.Result: True Positive (DDoS Attack - engage DDoS response, confirm mitigation)

Node.Condition: A small, single-source spike or a benign traffic anomaly.
A load-test or maintenance traffic surge mislabeled.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-NS-FLOOD, INV-02-NS-SOURCES to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: A benign traffic spike or single-source anomaly.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm no impact; close as benign_activity.
Engage DDoS response; confirm AED mitigation is holding; coordinate with the ISP/upstream; monitor service availability.
Confirm the test; document; whitelist if needed.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the target service and whether it is impacted.
Engage DDoS response; verify AED mitigation.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Engage DDoS response; confirm mitigation; coordinate upstream/ISP; monitor availability.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Tune AED protection thresholds; ensure upstream scrubbing; document the attack for capacity planning.

QualityChecks.Check: Threshold reduced 30->10 flood events/group/hour (baseline ~0-5/hr). deviceCustomString2 is the protected service.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: DDoS mitigated; service availability restored; attack documented.
